Compare Two Output Artifacts with Exact SHA-256 and Numeric Tolerance

Source: R/comparators.R
compare_artifacts.Rd

Fast-paths exact bit-for-bit verification via SHA-256. When digests differ and numeric tolerances (abs_tol/atol > 0 or rel_tol/rtol > 0) are permitted, recursively parses csv, tsv, json, or rds artifacts (including nested lists, data frames, matrices, and arrays) and verifies that every numeric element satisfies abs(a - b) <= abs_tol + rel_tol * max(|a|, |b|) while preserving exact NA/NaN/Inf alignment and exact equality for all non-numeric keys, columns, dimensions, and labels.

Usage

compare_artifacts(
  expected_path = NULL,
  actual_path,
  expected_sha256 = NULL,
  abs_tol = 0,
  rel_tol = 0,
  atol = NULL,
  rtol = NULL,
  format = "auto",
  ignore_attributes = FALSE,
  expected_raw = NULL
)

Arguments

expected_path

Path to the expected reference artifact (may be NULL if expected_sha256 and/or expected_raw is supplied).

actual_path

Path to the freshly reproduced artifact.

expected_sha256

Optional recorded SHA-256 hex digest of the expected artifact.

abs_tol

Non-negative absolute numeric tolerance (default 0).

rel_tol

Non-negative relative numeric tolerance (default 0).

atol

Optional alias for abs_tol; overrides abs_tol if non-NULL.

rtol

Optional alias for rel_tol; overrides rel_tol if non-NULL.

format

Artifact format: "auto" (default), "csv", "tsv", "json", "rds", "text", or "binary".

ignore_attributes

Logical; if TRUE, ignores vector/matrix name attributes during RDS comparison.

expected_raw

Optional raw vector of the expected artifact bytes (e.g., decoded from an embedded manifest snapshot).

Value

A list with fields status ("exact_match", "within_tolerance", "mismatch", or "missing"), passed (logical), expected_sha256, actual_sha256, max_abs_diff, max_rel_diff, abs_tol, rel_tol, and details.

Examples

f1 <- tempfile(fileext = ".csv")
f2 <- tempfile(fileext = ".csv")
write.csv(data.frame(k = c("a", "b"), est = c(1.0000, 2.0000)), f1, row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(data.frame(k = c("a", "b"), est = c(1.0002, 1.9999)), f2, row.names = FALSE)
compare_artifacts(f1, f2, atol = 1e-3, rtol = 1e-3)
#> $status
#> [1] "within_tolerance"
#> 
#> $passed
#> [1] TRUE
#> 
#> $expected_sha256
#> [1] "d866cc71e2f4ee64593b7fe1c6d28e12ca54dc38b01466a6897f9b65dab2273f"
#> 
#> $actual_sha256
#> [1] "ee8b465d4b8442e5980288088665f50302c446ab11957d9e9af589e0ec7f9ead"
#> 
#> $max_abs_diff
#> [1] 2e-04
#> 
#> $max_rel_diff
#> [1] 0.00019996
#> 
#> $abs_tol
#> [1] 0.001
#> 
#> $rel_tol
#> [1] 0.001
#> 
#> $details
#> [1] "Verified within tolerance (max_abs_diff=2e-04, max_rel_diff=2e-04)."
#> 
unlink(c(f1, f2))
